Kejiwa Alchemy creates high-potency alchemical elixirs for spiritual seekers and conscious practitioners.

Our handcrafted Ormus minerals, herbal tinctures, and botanical aromatics support meditation, consciousness expansion, and sacred living. Our bestseller, Frankincense, Myrrh & Gold Ormus (5★, 50+ reviews), is beloved for deepening spiritual connection and enhancing meditation practices.

What Makes Us Different:

  • Purest, highest-quality ingredients - We source only the finest botanicals and minerals
  • Handcrafted with intention - Every product is made with sacred care and alchemical precision
  • Loyal community - 60%+ repeat customer rate, customers buy 3-5+ times
  • Niche audience - Lightworkers, energy healers, meditation practitioners, spiritual coaches

How Affiliates Can Earn:

  • 15% commission on all sales (industry-leading rate for this niche!)
  • Average order: $75 = $11.25 per sale
  • 30-day cookie window
  • Performance-based upgrades available for top affiliates

How to Promote Us:

  • Best channels: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, spiritual/wellness blogs
  • Content ideas: Meditation routines, spiritual practices, product reviews, unboxing videos, transformation stories
  • We provide: Educational content, brand assets
  • Top performers: Authentic spiritual content creators who genuinely use and love the products

Other Information:

  • Product range: $22-$69 per item, bundles up to $122
  • Free shipping on orders $33+
  • Subscription options available
  • Responsive support - We're here to help you succeed
  • Ideal affiliates: Spiritual influencers, wellness bloggers, meditation teachers, holistic practitioners, conscious lifestyle creators
Join us in elevating consciousness, one elixir at a time! ✨

By signing up to be a Brand Ambassador with Kejiwa Alchemy you agree to the following:

The Beautiful Benefits of Being Our Affiliate Ambassador

Welcome to a journey that transcends ordinary affiliate partnerships! As a Kejiwa Alchemy Brand Ambassador, you're not just promoting products - you're sharing sacred tools that elevate consciousness and transform lives.
Your Life, Elevated:
  • Experience the profound energy shifts our high-vibe alchemy elixirs bring to your daily practice
  • Connect with a community of lightworkers, healers, and conscious souls
  • Align your income with your spiritual values by sharing products that truly serve
  • Feel the satisfaction of helping others discover their path to higher consciousness
  • Create abundance while spreading light and healing energy
Your Lifestyle, Rewarded:
  • Generate passive income by simply sharing what you love
  • Receive complimentary products to deepen your own spiritual journey
  • Build meaningful connections with fellow conscious entrepreneurs
  • Experience the joy of authentic sharing rather than pushy sales tactics

Your Personal Discount Code: 

Get 33% off all products for personal use.

⏰ Time Investment & Sacred Exchange

Affiliate Ambassador Program Path: The beauty of this program is its simplicity. Share your unique affiliate link and coupon codes with your community, and watch as your efforts bloom into commissions. The more intentionally you share these sacred tools with those who need them, the greater your opportunity for abundant returns.
Brand Ambassador Program Path: If you feel called to dive deeper into the Brand Ambassador Program, you'll step into the beautiful role of content creator. Through social media posts, stories, testimonials, and authentic sharing, you become a beacon of light for others seeking transformation. And you still receive all the benefits from the Affiliate Ambassador Program!
The Sacred Truth: The more love and energy you pour into promoting our alchemy creations through the Brand Ambassador Program, the more free products will flow to you for your content creation journey. It's a beautiful cycle of giving and receiving that honors the universal law of abundance.

💰 Payment Structure & Sacred Abundance

Monthly Flow: Your commissions are sent out monthly, with a minimum of $40 to ensure the energy exchange flows smoothly. For special circumstances, simply email us for early payout requests - we're here to support your needs.
Payment Methods:
  • PayPal (seamless and instant)
  • Zelle (quick and easy)
  • Bank Transfer ($2.50 processing fee applies, as this is what we're charged by the bank)
Update Your Payment Info: Navigate to your Dashboard → Settings → Payment to ensure your abundance flows to you without delay.

🎯 Commission Structure - Your Path to Prosperity

Your earning potential flows through two beautiful channels:
1. Affiliate Ambassador Program (Foundation Path): This is your foundation - the program you initially joined. Your unique link automatically generated for you carries the energy of your intention. Share it with your community, and every sale through your link generates commissions for you.
2. Coupon Code Sharing (Within Both Programs): Your personal coupon code is another powerful tool for generating abundance. Same beautiful commission structure applies whether you're in the Affiliate Ambassador Program or Brand Ambassador Program.
Find Your Details: All commission rates and program specifics can be found in your Dashboard under the "Program Details" tab. This is your sacred space for tracking your prosperity journey.

📈 Performance Expectations - Two Sacred Paths

Affiliate Ambassador Program Path: This is perfect for those who prefer gentle sharing with friends, family, and followers. Simply use your unique link when the moment feels right. No pressure, just authentic connection and natural flow.
Brand Ambassador Program Path: For souls called to deeper service through content creation:
Minimum Commitment: Share high-quality content featuring our products at least once per week.
Bonus Blessing: Generate over $50 monthly in commissions and receive an extra free gift in your product shipment.
Sacred Agreement: Consistent content creation ensures continuous flow of free products. If content creation pauses, product shipments will pause too - but you can always re-enter this beautiful flow by reaching out to us when you're ready to shine again.
Program Maintenance: To keep our sacred circle vibrant and manageable, we periodically review program participation. If there's no activity (link sharing, content creation, or engagement) for six months, we may need to remove inactive members from the program. This allows us to focus our energy on supporting active ambassadors while keeping the program flowing smoothly. Don't worry though - if you're ready to re-engage, simply reach out to us and we'll welcome you back with open arms! ✨

🎨 Promoting Channels & Content Creation Magic

Your Creative Playground:
  • Instagram posts and stories showcasing your authentic experience
  • Facebook posts sharing your transformation journey
  • TikTok videos capturing the magic of your practice
  • YouTube content diving deep into your spiritual journey
  • Blog posts about consciousness and wellness
  • Email newsletters to your community
  • Personal testimonials and reviews
Amplify Your Impact: Share our social profiles (@kejiwaalchemy), website links, and specific product pages to maximize your reach and commission potential. Every share sends ripples of positive energy into the world while building your abundance.
Content That Converts:
  • Behind-the-scenes of your spiritual practice
  • Before/after energy shifts you've experienced
  • Educational content about consciousness and alchemy
  • Authentic testimonials and product reviews
  • Lifestyle content showing products in your daily routine

🚚 Important: Keep Your Shipping Info Current

If you're participating in our Brand Ambassador Program and receiving free products, please ensure your shipping address is always current in your Dashboard → Settings → Profile. This ensures your sacred tools reach you without delay!


📋 Content Rights & Usage Agreement

Important Legal Notice:
By participating in our Brand Ambassador Program and sharing content featuring Kejiwa Alchemy products, you grant Kejiwa Alchemy unlimited, royalty-free rights to use, reproduce, modify, distribute, and display any content you create and share online about our products. This includes but is not limited to:
  • Social media posts, stories, and videos
  • Blog posts and articles
  • Reviews and testimonials
  • Photos and images featuring our products
  • Any other promotional content you create
What This Means:
  • We may use your content in our marketing campaigns, website, social media, advertisements, and any other promotional materials
  • We may edit, crop, or modify your content as needed for our marketing purposes
  • We may use your content across all platforms and marketing channels
  • No additional compensation is required beyond the free products and commissions already provided through the program
Your Responsibility: By sharing content about our products, you confirm that you have the right to grant these permissions and that your content doesn't infringe on any third-party rights.
This agreement ensures we can showcase the authentic experiences of our ambassador community while protecting both parties legally.
